message: Multipart property "color" has `encoding.color.explode: true`, so it must be an array, but its schema is not an array.
Multipart property "count" has `encoding.count.explode: true`, so it must be an array, but its schema is an integer.
Multipart property "metadata" has `encoding.metadata.explode: true`, so it must be an array, but its schema is an object.
Multipart property "nullableName" has `encoding.nullableName.explode: true`, so it must be an array, but its schema is a string.
